name: 垩白深褐烘焙早餐吐司款
description: 深褐板底暖垩白调吐司套图，覆盖痛点、组织对比与独立小袋规格

styleLock.backgroundSystem: warm chalk field #F2E9DB for packshots and info screens, deep roast-brown backdrop #2E1E14 for hero-benefit and closing screens, whitewashed wood #E0CDB2 for scene and trust flat lays
styleLock.lightingSystem: soft directional bakery light, warm key around 4300-5500K, skimming light across the crust for texture, soft contact shadows only
styleLock.surfaceSystem: whitewashed weathered wood #E0CDB2 and neutral oat board #F1E6D4, matte never glossy
styleLock.typography: modern humanist sans-serif, no brush calligraphy
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line bakery outline icons only, single accent color #D96A3C
styleLock.presentationRules: loaf always shown crust-side dominant with visible cut crumb; stable scale across the set
noDrift: no mixed fonts or brush calligraphy
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm artisan bakery visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of warm chalk field #F2E9DB, deep roast-brown backdrop #2E1E14, whitewashed wood surface #E0CDB2 and one persimmon-terracotta accent #D96A3C; soft directional bakery light with skimming crust highlights and soft contact shadows; modern humanist sans-serif; thin-line bakery outline icons in the single accent color; crust-side dominant product presentation with visible cut crumb and stable scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts or brush calligraphy, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no glossy plastic-looking crust rendering.

shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio light, soft front key with gentle fill, soft contact shadow

Negative: no props, no hands, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no cut-off edges, no plastic-looking food, no insects or contamination, no unrealistic portion size.

provenance.notes: 逐屏事实：P1 深色幕布早餐场景，多片带果粒吐司切面立在木板上，配咖啡杯与绿植盆栽，大标题为早餐吐司面包；P2 优质原料四宫格（小麦粉/乳粉/鸡蛋/黄油，图为空白占位块）；P3 整条切片吐司与牛奶碗场景，深色幕布；P4 产品信息页：品名早餐吐司面包，配料为小麦粉、饮用水、食用植物油、白砂糖、黄油、食用盐，加工方式冷加工调理面包，贮藏写阴凉干燥避免阳光直射，生产日期与保质期均写见包装打印处，多种口味为多种酸奶风味小口袋；P5 三张工艺卡（严控烘焙时间/醇味食材/热加工工艺，图为空白占位）加编织篮燕麦顶面包场景；P6-P7 产品细节卡：柔软酸甜、甄选原料、独立包装随身携带、开袋即食；P8 与 P1 同场景复用；P9 编织篮面包与深色幕布整条吐司；P10 切片吐司与牛奶碗，左下角有会员招募二维码贴片（已剥离）。品类判定依据：预包装调理面包、独立小袋多口味、开袋即食、保质期见包装打印处，属常温预包装零食烘焙而非现制短保烘焙，故归食品饮料/休闲零食而非生鲜粮油；源夹名为食品不改判 L1 方向。已剥离：二维码会员招募贴片、原品牌字与系列名、原文案原句、具体包装美术，产品一律以 {product} 占位，参数区数值全部改 {callout_n} 或空白占位，未写入任何净含量/保质期/成分含量数值，源页 P4 配料与 P5 工艺表述不作为事实搬运。与近似模版差异：库内同段已有 suite-shipinyinliao-luoxuanwen-shousi-mianbao（钴蓝 #2B5EA6 冷调几何平涂体系）与本套不同——本套为暖调「暖垩白 #F2E9DB + 深烘焙褐 #2E1E14 + 烤木台色 #E0CDB2 + 柿陶橘 #D96A3C」烘焙晨光体系，四色均未见于该套；背景体系改用 chalk 幕布加深褐板底交替而非钴蓝色块切割；道具改用木垫块、空白小袋、牛奶杯与绿植而非钴蓝台阶与荧光绿徽章框；机位含仰视收口与 90 度俯视规格页，角色序列 HERO>HERO>PAIN_POINT>SCENE>DETAIL>COMPARISON>DETAIL>VARIANT>TRUST>CTA 与库内各套均不同；另外同段近期暖麦色调吐司体系（燕麦奶白/麦黄/琥珀）亦不复用，本套深褐板底加柿陶橘强调为全新构成。
